name: Keychain storage
description: A small Keychain wrapper for tokens and credentials, kept on this device only, plus an in-memory store for previews.
usage: Store secrets through `any SecureStore`: use `KeychainStore()` at the composition root and `InMemorySecureStore()` in previews and tests. Never put tokens in UserDefaults or @AppStorage.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify keychain-storage` on a Mac with XcodeGen.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
